firstPlayerRule: No one goes first: players do not take turns in any particular order. After everyone signals they are ready, whoever believes they hold the lowest available card simply plays it.
clarifications: Before each level, each ready player places one hand palm down on the table; once everyone is ready, hands are removed and play begins.
Each player must always play the lowest card they hold, one card at a time, without sharing any information.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rules sheet from the 1j1ju rulebook library (the Pandasaurus product page links its rulebook only through a Dropbox work-preview link) and extracted the text of both PDF pages. Introduction and Course of the game: 'The players do not take turns in any particular order. Whoever wants to put down a card, simply does so' and 'Whoever believes they have the lowest card currently available, simply plays it.' Readiness is signalled by a hand on the table. The sheet credits Wolfgang Warsch and ends with the NSV address (nsv.de), matching BGG 244992. SHA-256: 06a5c4cda30b4c7fc4b4530da800d84c1078575e8f5ca5681242f7ec7c3e1a0a. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The cited PDF is a third-party-hosted copy of the NSV English sheet, not a publisher-hosted file; the Pandasaurus North American rulebook was not directly accessible.
